Support

One address, read by a person. There is no ticket number to quote and no form to fill in - write in your own words, include the few things below, and you will not have to send a second message to be understood.

Email us

support@marginpad.io

Account questions, a trade that looks wrong, a payout, a leaderboard place, the API - all of it goes here. Write from the address your MarginPad account uses if you can; it is how we find you without asking.

We read everything. We do not publish a response time, because we would rather be slow than promise a number we miss.

Telegram

The bot handles alerts, your account and the daily wrap: @MarginPadBot. Announcements go out on @marginpad. For anything that needs a human answer, use the email above.

Other traders

The chat on any page and the community are often faster for "how does this work" than we are, and the people there have usually hit the same thing.

What to include

Most messages that take a week to resolve take a week because the first reply has to ask for one of these.

  • Your username - not your display name on a board, the one you sign in with.
  • The trade id, if it is about a trade. Open the ticket on My Trades and copy it; it looks like trade:e8b4cb68d7. Without it we are guessing which of your trades you mean.
  • What you expected and what happened, in that order. "My SEI long closed at 4,300% and is not on the ROE board" is answerable on the first reply. "The leaderboard is broken" is not.
  • When, roughly, and in UTC if you know it. Everything we store is stamped in UTC.
  • For the API: the endpoint, the exact error body we sent back, and whether the key is the one you created most recently.

Answer it yourself, faster

Three things come up often enough to be worth checking before you write.

  • Is something actually down? The status page is live, ungated and keeps 90 days. If the trading store is green there, the problem is your account or your code, not ours.
  • Did the API refuse you? Every refusal carries a reason and a hint in the body - read that first; the error table explains each one in full.
  • Is your plan what you think it is? GET /api/bot/v1/usage states your plan, every ceiling on it, and when it ends.
